title: Provenance graph: declarations versus verification
summary: Dev11 keeps the full dev10 historical evidence identity but removes whole-graph uncertainty contamination from individual comparisons. Contradictory tip lineages taint their own child occurrences and downstream dependency chains; cyclic ancestry blocks only affected queries. Disconnected parts retain evidence-level relationships. CORROBORATION_CLAIM is not dependency and absent links are never proofs of independence.
invariants: CORROBORATION_CLAIM is not confirmation of corroboration.
Use explicit evidence references and source identity; do not substitute shared domain, publisher or syndication speculation for evidence.
Unknown relationship must project as INDEPENDENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED.
Current graph is source-level and timeless: no per-occurrence or quoted-span ancestry, no historical edge revocation or immutable snapshot, no independent verification.
Cross-publisher article counts must not be interpreted as independent origins without a verified source lineage/selection frame.

provenance.claim: Exact dev8 source implementation of multi-parent graph.
